text: Listen, [VAR 0100(0000)]. I’ve been thinking...\c\nIf you’re a Pokémon Trainer now, you must want\nto try your hand at the [VAR FF00(0006)]Gym Challenge[VAR FF00(0000)], right?[VAR 0114(0005)]
The Gym Challenge, mate!\c\nThe annual competition where Trainers can battle\nit out for the right to challenge the Champion![VAR 0114(0005)]

But the trick is that you’ve got to be endorsed
if you want to take part.\c
And Lee doesn’t seem to think I’m up to snuff...\c
So I’m thinking I ought to talk to the professor
and see if she could help![VAR 0114(0005)]

You’ve got to take part, too!\c
A proper rival is just the thing every Trainer
needs to keep growing stronger, after all.
Keeps you motivated, right?[VAR 0114(0005)]
The professor’s house is way down at the end of\nRoute 2, so let’s head there...and give our teams\r\nthe chance to train up a bit along the way![VAR 0114(0005)]
